_comment: Pins RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.3 and Section 7.5: SessionCancel, SessionSuspend and SessionResume are appended only by the runtime, through the CancelSession, SuspendSession and ResumeSession RPCs. A Send of any of them is rejected and leaves the session OPEN. Message 1 is an accepted Proposal so the session has a mode state to preserve.
description: Core lifecycle: runtime-emitted annotations submitted via Send are rejected.

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.3: SessionCancel is runtime-emitted and MUST NOT be submitted via Send, even by the initiator. The RFC names no error code for this rejection; the code here is the one the reference runtime returns.

RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.5: SessionSuspend is runtime-emitted and MUST NOT be submitted via Send, even by the initiator. The RFC names no error code for this rejection; the code here is the one the reference runtime returns.

RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.5: SessionResume is runtime-emitted and MUST NOT be submitted via Send, even by the initiator. The RFC names no error code for this rejection; the code here is the one the reference runtime returns.
